items.source: this builder
items.translation: 此构建器

items.source: Configure the codecs for the WebClient in the underlying ExchangeStrategies.
items.translation: 配置 `WebClient` 的底层 ExchangeStrategies 中的编解码器。

items.source: Provide a pre-configured UriBuilderFactory instance as an alternative to and effectively overriding baseUrl(String).
items.translation: 提供一个预配置的UriBuilderFactory实例，作为baseUrl(String)的替代方案并实际上覆盖它。

items.source: Configure a base URI as described in WebClient.create(String).
items.translation: 按照WebClient.create(String)中所述配置基础 URI。

items.source: Build the WebTestClient instance.
items.translation: 构建 `WebTestClient` 实例。

items.source: By default, this is initialized and set internally. However, the connector may also be prepared externally and passed via WebTestClient.bindToServer(ClientHttpConnector) such as for MockMvcWebTestClient tests, and in that case you can use this from WebTestClient.mutateWith(WebTestClientConfigurer) to replace it.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此连接器在内部初始化并设置。但是，也可以通过WebTestClient.bindToServer(ClientHttpConnector)从外部准备该连接器并传递它，例如用于MockMvcWebTestClient测试；在这种情况下，您可以使用WebTestClient.mutateWith(WebTestClientConfigurer)来替换它。

items.source: For most cases, prefer using codecs(Consumer) which allows customizing the codecs in the ExchangeStrategies rather than replace them. That ensures multiple parties can contribute to codecs configuration.
items.translation: 对于大多数情况，建议使用codecs(Consumer)来自定义ExchangeStrategies中的编解码器，而不是替换它们。这样可以确保多个方都能为编解码器配置做出贡献。

items.source: By default this is set to ExchangeStrategies.withDefaults().
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为ExchangeStrategies.withDefaults()。

items.source: Note that the configured consumer does not apply to responses decoded to Flux<T> which can be consumed outside the workflow of the test client, for example via reactor.test.StepVerifier.
items.translation: 请注意，配置的消费者不适用于解码为 `Flux<T>` 的响应，此类响应可以在测试客户端的工作流之外进行消费，例如通过 `reactor.test.StepVerifier`。

items.source: By default 5 seconds.
items.translation: 默认值为 5 秒。

items.source: This can be useful for applying pre-packaged customizations.
items.translation: 这可用于应用预打包的自定义配置。

items.source: Configure an ApiVersionInserter to abstract how an API version specified via WebTestClient.RequestHeadersSpec.apiVersion(Object) is inserted into the request.
items.translation: 配置一个ApiVersionInserter，以抽象通过WebTestClient.RequestHeadersSpec.apiVersion(Object)指定的 API 版本如何插入到请求中。

items.source: Manipulate the default headers with the given consumer. The headers provided to the consumer are "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing header values, remove values, or use any of the other HttpHeaders methods.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操作默认标头。提供给 Consumer 的标头为“live”，以便该 Consumer 可用于 覆盖现有标头值、移除值，或使用任何其他的 HttpHeaders 方法。

items.source: Manipulate the default cookies with the given consumer. The map provided to the consumer is "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing header values, remove values, or use any of the other MultiValueMap methods.
items.translation: 使用给定的消费者操作默认 Cookie。提供给消费者的 Map 是“活动”的，因此该消费者可用于 覆盖 现有的 Header 值、移除 值，或使用任何其他 MultiValueMap 方法。

items.source: Set the ClientHttpConnector to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的ClientHttpConnector。

items.source: Configure the ExchangeStrategies to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的ExchangeStrategies。

items.source:
Global option to specify an API version to add to every request,
if not already set.
items.translation: 全局选项，用于指定要添加到每个请求中的 API 版本（如果尚未设置）。

items.source: Add the given cookie to all requests that haven't already added it.
items.translation: 将给定的 Cookie 添加到尚未添加该 Cookie 的所有请求中。

items.source: Add the given header to all requests that haven't added it.
items.translation: 为所有未添加该标头的请求添加此标头。

items.source: Add the given filter to the filter chain.
items.translation: 将给定的过滤器添加到过滤器链中。

items.source:
Manipulate the filters with the given consumer. The
list provided to the consumer is "live", so that the consumer can be used to remove
filters, change ordering, etc.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操作过滤器。提供给 Consumer 的列表是“实时”的，因此该 Consumer 可用于移除过滤器、更改排序等。

items.source: cookieName - the cookie name
items.translation: cookieName - Cookie 名称

items.source: cookieValues - the cookie values
items.translation: cookieValues - Cookie 值

items.source: apiVersionInserter - the inserter to use
items.translation: apiVersionInserter - 要使用的插入器

items.source: filtersConsumer - a function that consumes the filter list
items.translation: filtersConsumer - 一个消费过滤器列表的函数

items.source: configurer - the configurer to apply
items.translation: configurer - 要应用的配置器

items.source: timeout - the response timeout value
items.translation: timeout - 响应超时值

items.source: connector - the connector to use
items.translation: connector - 要使用的连接器

items.source: consumer - the consumer to apply to entity responses
items.translation: consumer - 要应用于实体响应的消费者

items.source: ApiVersionInserter exposes shortcut methods for several built-in inserter implementation types. See the class-level Javadoc of ApiVersionInserter for a list of choices.
items.translation: ApiVersionInserter 为几种内置的插入器实现类型提供了快捷方法。有关选项列表，请参阅 ApiVersionInserter 的类级别 Javadoc。

items.source: Steps to customize the underlying WebClient via WebClient.Builder.
items.translation: 通过WebClient.Builder自定义底层WebClient的步骤。

items.source: Configure an EntityExchangeResult callback that is invoked every time after a response is fully decoded to a single entity, to a List of entities, or to a byte[].
items.translation: 配置一个 `EntityExchangeResult` 回调，该回调在每次响应被完全解码为单个实体、实体列表或 `byte[]` 后调用。

items.source: Apply the given configurer to this builder instance.
items.translation: 将此配置器应用到该构建器实例。

items.source: Manipulate the default cookies with the given consumer.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操纵默认 Cookie。

items.source: Manipulate the default headers with the given consumer.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操纵默认标头。

items.source: Manipulate the filters with the given consumer.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操纵过滤器。

items.source: Max amount of time to wait for responses.
items.translation: 等待响应的最大时间量。

items.source: headersConsumer - a function that consumes the HttpHeaders
items.translation: headersConsumer - 一个消费 HttpHeaders 的函数

items.source: headerName - the header name
items.translation: headerName - 标头名称

items.source: headerValues - the header values
items.translation: headerValues - 标头值

items.source: cookiesConsumer - a function that consumes the cookies map
items.translation: cookiesConsumer - 一个消费 cookies 映射的函数

items.source: version - the version to use
items.translation: version - 要使用的版本

items.source: filter - the filter to be added to the chain
items.translation: filter - 要添加到链中的过滤器

items.source: strategies - the strategies to use
items.translation: strategies - 要使用的策略

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Brian Clozel, Sam Brannen, Michał Rowicki
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev，Brian Clozel，Sam Brannen，Michał Rowicki

items.source: the builder
items.translation: 构建器
